label: Revived Sor Juana’s Mexican feminist claim to philosophical reason
description: Castellanos explicitly invoked Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz as her intellectual foremother, diagnosing how colonial-patriarchal society continued to deny women cultural authorship.
dialecticalTension: Connects Baroque New Spain feminism to 20th-century Mexican existential feminism.
historicalContext: Sobre cultura femenina (1950) & Mujer que sabe latín (1973).

label: Synthesized Beauvoirian existential feminism with Mexican and Chiapas realities
description: Writing Sobre cultura femenina right alongside The Second Sex, Castellanos engaged Beauvoir to critique how women are made immanent "Other" in Mexican society.
dialecticalTension: Grounds existentialist critique of "feminine mystique" in Latin American race and class.

label: Catalyzed Mexican feminist moral philosophy pioneered by Hierro
description: Hierro built directly on Castellanos’s interrogation of Mexican gender culture to establish academic feminist ethics at UNAM.
dialecticalTension: Establishes continuous 20th-century Mexican feminist philosophy lineage.
historicalContext: UNAM Faculty of Philosophy and Letters (1950s–1980s).
